Evidence Reports.PORT: Public report gateway port; Evidence itself stays on loopback 3001.
Evidence Reports.EVIDENCE_BASIC_USER: Generated shared viewer username. Retrieve from service variables.
Evidence Reports.EVIDENCE_BASIC_PASSWORD: Generated shared viewer password. Rotate and redeploy to invalidate credentials.
Evidence Reports.EVIDENCE_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: Disable the official CLI startup and heartbeat telemetry.
Evidence Reports.REPORT_DB_HOST: Private warehouse DNS name, never its public TCP endpoint.
Evidence Reports.REPORT_DB_NAME: Fixture database name; the initial schema expects reports.
Evidence Reports.REPORT_DB_USER: SELECT-only connection role; never use the warehouse administrator.
Evidence Reports.REPORT_DB_PASSWORD: References the warehouse reader secret; initial-volume setup only.
Evidence Reports.REPORT_DB_SSLMODE: disable only for this private fixture network; external PostgreSQL requires verify-full.

Warehouse.POSTGRES_DB: Initial database name reports; changing it requires a migration.
Warehouse.POSTGRES_USER: Private database administrator, not passed to the report service.
Warehouse.POSTGRES_PASSWORD: Generated administrator password; initial-volume setup only.
Warehouse.REPORT_DB_PASSWORD: Generated restricted role password; rotate with ALTER ROLE, not only an environment edit.
Warehouse.PGDATA: Persistent PostgreSQL cluster under the warehouse volume.
